# Nurlift

Nurlift connects brands to technologies and growth models for the new era of discovery.

## Primary product
- Dropper: Brand Intelligence and AI Discovery platform that helps brands understand where they appear, how they are perceived, which narratives are growing, how they compare with competitors, and where to act.

## Capabilities
- Brand Intelligence
- AI Discovery
- Competitive Intelligence
- Narrative Intelligence
- Local Discovery

## Languages
- Portuguese: https://nurlift.com/
- English: https://nurlift.com/en/
